Taiwan’s Defense Ministry reported that two Russian military aircraft entered the island’s Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ) on November 17.

According to the ministry, the aircraft entered from the northeast, flew along Taiwan’s eastern coast and exited south of Taitung County. Taiwan said it took appropriate response measures but did not specify what they were. The aircraft types were not identified.

The report came the same day Japan said two suspected Russian aircraft had entered its airspace northwest of Okinoshima, remaining there for about three minutes. Japanese fighter jets were scrambled and warnings were issued to the crews.
